column1: # Yoshi and the Mysterious Book (Switch 2, update v131072, version 1.0.2)

# Unreal Engine 5.4.4 (SDK MW+EpicGames+UnrealEngine-5_4_4 in main; the deferred renderer, SP_GLSL_SAGE shaders), SDK 20.5.15 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2. Modules main + subsdk2 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# Packed from a NUP container (scripts/pack_nup.py). subsdk0 (NVIDIA's DLSS library) and subsdk1 (CUDA) are not loaded: main takes nothing from them that the host does not supply
# a 3D field the left stick walks through, with both triggers in use
# v131072 is the update's title version, the title screen says Ver. 1.0.2 (the NUP carries no display version)
# The game sets near-zero NVN depth (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode); offline pipeline bases use main0_z.

# Unreal Engine 5.4: nninitStartup reserves one 62 GB region for the engine; the rewriter's engine-wide rules cut the FMallocBinned3 constructor call (the host runs Unreal's heap on a malloc zone, dm/tools/ue_malloc.py,

# hle_uemalloc.c) and give the region what the alias region has room for, 4.06 GB (dm/tools/ue_region.py, hle_svc.c); the SDK's node area is cut to 62 MB (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py, the SDK-wide rule). Engage's 5 GB block:

# 256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stacks + 128 MB heap. Mapped up to +3.00 GB in the alias region in the first habitat. The NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on

# Each material's shaders inline in its cooked package, the packages in the IoStore container (PJ045-Sage.utoc), the global shaders in the pak: shader_split.py ue_legacy_jobs, uepak.shader_map_entries, uepak.sage_record
